police.speaker: Detective Morris
police.text: Morris's team finds a lookout, but the person escapes toward the river.

signal.speaker: Amara
signal.text: The bell rhythm points to an abandoned rail spur hidden beyond the trees.

alone.speaker: David
alone.text: David finds Ethan's drawing beneath a stone: a bridge and three dark windows.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: The quarry road divides at the forest. One track is heavy with mud; the other is nearly invisible beneath fallen leaves.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: Amara finds a small shoe lace tied around a branch. Ethan used that knot to mark the way home.

dialogues.speaker: Victor
dialogues.text: The trail reaches a fork. Victor's voice comes from both directions at once.

choices.label: Ask Morris to cover both trails
choices.impact: Morris can cover both forest paths, but splitting the team leaves each group smaller.
choices.response: Morris: I will take the upper path and send a second team toward the river.
choices.speaker: Detective Morris

choices.label: Use the train bell to choose the lower path
choices.impact: Amara can use the crossing bell to pick a route, but the signal is fading.
choices.response: Amara: I will count the bell rhythm and guide you toward the rail spur.
choices.speaker: Amara

choices.label: Follow Ethan's marked trail without backup
choices.impact: Ethan's knot may lead home, but following it means David moves alone.
choices.response: David: I will follow Ethan's mark and call out before I leave the trail.
choices.speaker: David

metadata.episode: A continuing rescue mystery; the final clue opens the next episode.
